seeds.text: Your body has been with you from the first breath. It's the most loyal thing you have, even when you treat it like the enemy.
Home isn't a place. It's the felt sense of being here — which is portable the moment you can find it.
Your body is political, ancestral, tender, and wise — all at once. Splitting those off is what makes it feel foreign.
The body remembers safety the same way it remembers danger — through repetition. Give it small, repeated reasons to believe again.
You are not in your body. You are your body. The "you" that lives separate from it is a thought, not a fact.

slides.composition: A glitching, fragmented chrome figure standing in a vast, empty void, reflecting distorted light, conveying a sense of separation and unease.

slides.text: Your body is the most loyal thing you have. It never left you.
slides.composition: A single, ancient, polished obsidian stone resting on a shimmering, liquid silver surface, radiating a steady, quiet luminescence from within.

slides.text: The 'you' separate from it is a thought. You are all of it.
slides.composition: Close-up of two hands, one metallic chrome and one soft, human-like, gently merging at the fingertips against a nebula backdrop, blurring the lines between them.

slides.text: Feeling foreign in your own skin? It's the cost of splitting yourself off.
slides.composition: An ornate, empty chrome cage, slightly ajar, casting long, distorted shadows across a dreamy, pastel-gradient floor, hinting at an internal division.

slides.text: Your body learns safety through tiny repetitions. Give it reasons to believe.
slides.composition: A series of delicate, glowing prismatic orbs floating in a gentle spiral, each reflecting tiny, consistent pinpricks of light in a soft, cosmic expanse.

slides.text: It's not about fixing. It's about witnessing what is already here.
slides.composition: A single, stylized, cel-shaded eye, partially obscured by a shimmering veil of light, gazing calmly at a reflection of itself in still, chrome water.

slides.text: You don't need to go anywhere to be home.
slides.composition: A softly glowing, arched architectural portal opening onto a serene, starry inner landscape, inviting a sense of quiet belonging and inner peace.

caption:
Been feeling disconnected from yourself lately? This is for you. It's not about forcing anything, just coming back to the truest home you've got. It's okay. You're here now.
